title: Steampunk Mermaid Diver
description: A female mermaid with a metallic blue and gold mechanical tail wears an ornate brass diving helmet adorned with red-tipped arrows. She holds a long spear in one hand while raising the other, surrounded by small fish in a surreal underwater desert landscape featuring oil derricks under a dramatic sunset sky.
prompt: A majestic steampunk mermaid with blue and gold mechanical tail and ornate brass diving helmet decorated with red arrows, holding a spear, swimming through an underwater desert with oil derricks in the background. Dramatic sunset sky with orange and purple hues, small fish swimming around her, cinematic lighting, painterly style with visible brushstrokes.
